# narrated in

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:narratedIn`](gmeow-narratedIn.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/narratedIn>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)

Flat 80% seam link, content-side orientation: the diegetic entity or event appears in the segment. The projection-friendly direction — Wikidata P1441 'present in work' is exactly this edge (SSSOM row deferred to the alignment window). Domain intentionally open. NOT the inverse-axiom twin of [`gmeow:narrates`](gmeow-narrates.md): no [owl:inverseOf](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#inverseOf) is asserted, so EL stays clean and either orientation can be used without entailing the other; consumers query both (the [`connectsTo`](gmeow-connectsTo.md) convention).
